note: BAC Honduras's tariff of commissions for personal savings and cheque accounts (F-HON-0001676, V.31; an image-only document read by eye): it lists no maintenance or minimum-balance charge for the Crece savings account, only charges at the time of a request (passbook or card replacement, statements, transfers, ATM withdrawals beyond the sixth); the Mastercard Preferente debit card's annual membership is the card's and isn't modelled here.

sources.title: BAC Honduras, F-HON-0001676 Tarifario de cuentas de ahorro y cheques persona natural V.31
sources.said: Uso de cuenta bancaria: Reposición de libreta (por pérdida o robo) L100.00; Reposición de tarjeta de débito L150.00; Membresía Tarjeta débito Mastercard Preferente L600.00, cobro anual. Monto de apertura: Crece/Crece Foranea L1000.00/L500.00. (Read by eye from the image-only document; no maintenance or minimum-balance charge appears on any of its six pages.)
